run_f_gold: run f_gold to count subarrays with equal number of 1s and 0s in an array
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled using the provided parameter sets and print success count
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to avoid mutating the input array when converting 0s to -1s
review_f_gold: review f_gold prefix sum approach that uses a hash map to count zero-sum subarrays
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which counts subarrays with equal 1s and 0s using cumulative sum and a dictionary
